rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is functioning properly.

example.english: The computer is working normally now.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 ji4 gaa1 wan6 zok3 zing3 soeng4

rows.note: Use this for knowledge that is usable in practice (sense 11) or something practical for real-world use (sense 12).

example.english: The methods in this book are practical for working in real life.
example.traditional: 呢本書教嘅方法好實用，學完就可以喺工作上用。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 gaau3 ge3 fong1 faat3 hou2 sat6 jung6 hok6 jyun4 zau6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6 jung6

rows.jyutping: tung4 gung1 zok3 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this adjectival construction for something related to employment or workplace matters.

example.english: This meeting is about working matters.
example.traditional: 呢個係同工作有關嘅會議。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung4 gung1 zok3 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 wui2 ji5

rows.note: Use this for a provisional version or draft that is usable for now but not final.

example.english: The working date for the meeting is provisionally set as the first of next month.
example.traditional: 會議日期暫定為下個月一號。
example.jyutping: wui2 ji5 jat6 kei4 zaam6 ding6 wai4 haa6 go3 jyut6 jat1 hou6
